newsitem.title: GERMANY: German parliament passes sick pay cuts.
newsitem.headline: German parliament passes sick pay cuts.

text.p: The German parliament on Friday approved the government's reforms to the country's health system, a key part of Bonn's austerity drive that should save around 7.0 billion marks ($4.63 billion) next year.

Chancellor Helmut Kohl won an absolute majority for the bill, the last of three key votes on the austerity package, overturning objections lodged by the opposition Social Democrat-controlled upper house of parliament on Thursday.
